tasks.title: Persist issue start prerequisites
tasks.description: Add storage for issue-level start prerequisites as explicit relationships between Issues in the same project. The local store must support recording prerequisite issues and reading enough prerequisite data to evaluate circular declarations without parsing Issue body text.
acceptanceCriteria: A migration creates persistent storage for Issue start prerequisites with uniqueness and lookup support
Issue #201 can persist Issue #200 as a prerequisite issue and read it back after repository reload
Stored start prerequisites are not copied into or read from task-level tasks.json dependsOn
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes existing Issue storage and produces the repository/schema foundation used by all later tasks.

tasks.title: Implement start eligibility domain service
tasks.spec: specs/issue-prerequisites/spec.md#Start eligibility summarizes whether an Issue may enter the pipeline
tasks.description: Implement the domain service that declares start prerequisites, evaluates prerequisite issue delivery, computes start eligibility, and rejects circular prerequisite declarations. The service must use the delivered rule stage=done, status=completed, and mergeState=merged, and must represent waiting for delivery without changing Issue status to blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Declaring Issue #201 requires Issue #200 records a start prerequisite and exposes it in structured Issue data
A prerequisite issue is delivered only when stage=done, status=completed, and mergeState=merged
Issue #201 reports startEligibility.startable=false and waitingForDelivery includes #200 while #200 is not delivered
Issue #201 becomes startable after #200 is delivered without deleting the prerequisite
Direct and indirect circular prerequisite declarations are rejected with reason circular-prerequisite
Waiting for delivery does not set status=blocked or create agent/session failure state
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes T-001 repository/schema output and produces the shared start eligibility API for backend callers.

tasks.title: Expose prerequisites and guard API starts
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Start handler 校验 issue status
tasks.description: Wire the Issue prerequisite service into HTTP issue list/detail responses, declaration endpoints, and POST /api/issues/:number/start. API clients must receive structured prerequisites, startEligibility, and waitingForDelivery data, and rejected starts must not enqueue start-pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues and GET /api/issues/:number include prerequisites and startEligibility for each Issue
A structured API request can declare that Issue #201 requires Issue #200 before start
A circular prerequisite declaration returns a 400-class response with reason circular-prerequisite and does not persist the rejected prerequisite
POST /api/issues/201/start returns a 400-class response with an actionable waiting-for-delivery message when #200 is not delivered
Rejected API start responses include startEligibility.waitingForDelivery identifying #200
Rejected API starts do not enqueue start-pipeline
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts and shared Issue API types
tasks.notes: Consumes the T-002 service result shape and produces the structured server contract used by CLI and Web UI.

tasks.title: Backstop queued start-pipeline execution
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run/spec.md#REQ-WR-001 Starting an issue creates a WorkflowRun
tasks.description: Apply the same start eligibility guard inside queued start-pipeline execution before worktree creation, WorkflowRun start, or agent session creation. A queued task for an Issue waiting for prerequisite delivery must be skipped with a waiting reason rather than treated as workflow, agent, or session failure.
acceptanceCriteria: A stale queued start-pipeline task for Issue #201 waiting for #200 is skipped before worktree creation
The skipped queued task does not create or start a WorkflowRun
The skipped queued task does not create an agent session
The skipped queued task records or logs the waiting-for-delivery reason without marking Issue #201 blocked
A start-pipeline task proceeds normally after all prerequisite issues are delivered
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the T-002 guard and protects the T-003 API contract from stale or manually queued work.

tasks.title: Render prerequisite state in CLI
tasks.spec: specs/cli-interface/spec.md#CLI start uses server start eligibility rejection
tasks.description: Update CLI issue commands to declare start prerequisites through the server API and render server-provided start eligibility data. The CLI must show concise waiting-for-delivery reasons in list/show/start flows and remain a thin client that does not parse Issue body text.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI can declare that Issue #201 requires Issue #200 before start through a structured API request
mo issue list and mo issue show render a waiting reason equivalent to Waiting for #200 from startEligibility.waitingForDelivery
mo issue show displays prerequisite issues and whether each prerequisite issue is delivered
mo issue start 201 prints the server-provided waiting-for-delivery rejection and exits non-zero when #200 is not delivered
CLI does not parse Issue body text to infer start prerequisites or waiting reasons
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the T-003 API fields and declaration endpoints.

tasks.title: Render prerequisite state in Web UI
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#Web UI shows start prerequisites on Issue Detail
tasks.description: Update Web UI issue surfaces to consume structured prerequisites and startEligibility data. Issue Detail should show prerequisite delivery states, cards should show Waiting for #N, Start controls should explain waiting for delivery, and the UI should provide only a minimal prerequisite declaration interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue Detail lists prerequisite issues and indicates delivered versus waiting for delivery states
Issue cards show a concise waiting reason equivalent to Waiting for #200 when startEligibility.waitingForDelivery contains #200
The Start control prevents or rejects start for Issue #201 waiting for #200 and shows the server-provided message
The Web UI can declare from Issue #201 that prerequisite Issue #200 must be delivered before start
Circular prerequisite declaration errors are shown without adding the rejected prerequisite to the UI
The Web UI does not parse Issue descriptions to infer start prerequisites
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the T-003 server contract and can run after the API surface is available.

tasks.title: Add prerequisite regression coverage
tasks.spec: specs/issue-prerequisites/spec.md#Waiting for delivery is not a failure state
tasks.description: Add focused backend, CLI, and Web UI regression tests for the complete start prerequisite behavior. Tests should prove declaration, delivery evaluation, circular rejection, API start rejection, queue backstop behavior, visible waiting reasons, and separation from task-level tasks.json dependsOn.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests cover prerequisite persistence, delivered evaluation, startEligibility.waitingForDelivery, and circular declaration rejection
API tests prove rejected starts do not enqueue start-pipeline and include structured startEligibility data
Queue execution tests prove waiting Issues do not create WorkflowRun or agent session state
CLI tests cover waiting-for-delivery rendering and start rejection messaging
Web UI tests cover Issue Detail prerequisites, card waiting reason, and Start control behavior
Tests prove task-level tasks.json dependsOn is not interpreted as an issue-level start prerequisite
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli tests and web component tests for issue start prerequisites
tasks.notes: Consumes all implemented backend and UI behavior. This final task validates the full acceptance criteria chain.
